AMENDMENT NO. 1 SEPTEMBER 2018 
TO 
IS 16464 (PART 4) : 2015/ISO/IEC 19784-4 : 2011 INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY — 
BIOMETRIC APPLICATION PROGRAMMING INTERFACE 


PART 4 BIOMETRIC SENSOR FUNCTION PROVIDER INTERFACE 


This amendment is identical with corrigendum! (2013) to ISO/IEC 19784-4 : 2011 issued by International 
Organization for Standardization (ISO) and International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC). 


TECHNICAL CORRIGENDUM 1 


RECTIFICATIF TECHNIQUE 1 


Technical Corrigendum 1 to ISO/IEC 19784-4:2011 was prepared by Joint Technical Committee ISO/IEC 
JTC 1, Information technology, Subcommittee SC 37, Biometrics. 


1. Add in 6.2.1 after BioSFPI_BSFPLoad: 


— BioSFPI_BSFPUnload (called to tell the BFP to free all internal resources before termination) 


2. Insert after 8.2.1: 


8.2.2 BioSFPI_BSFPUnload 


BioAPI_ RETURN BioAPI BioSFPI_BSFPUnload 
(const BioAPI_UUID *BSFPUuid, 
BioSFPI EventHandler BioSFPINotifyCallback) ; 


Amendment No. 1 to IS 16464 (Part 4) : 2015/ISO/IEC 19784-4 : 2011 


Description 
This function disables events and de-registers the BSP event-notification function. The BSFP shall perform 
cleanup operations, reversing the initialisation performed in BioSFPI_BSFPLoad. 


Parameters 
BSFPUuid (input) — The UUID of the invoked BSFP. 


BioSFPINotifyCallback (input) — A function pointer for the event handler that manages events of type 
BioAPI_EVENT. 


Return Value 


A BioAPILRETURN value indicating success or specifying a particular error condition. The value 
BioAPI_OK indicates success. All other values represent an error condition. 


Errors 
BioAPIERR INVALID UUID 


(LITD 17) 


Publication Unit, BIS, New Delhi, India
